statement: Version 1.72 introduces the atom collider.
Atom collider is built in construction at the very last one at the top.
Atom collider costs nello salts and shattered skulls (Purgatory stalker base material).
Once built the atom collider appears at the top of World 3 next to the EZ totem.
Atom collider is a buffing tool like a later-game Salt Lick but uses atoms instead of salts.
Change the conversion threshold before turning it on; default 15 million converts everything above that in storage into atoms.
He lost his stacks by turning it on with default threshold and must regrind 3D prints.
Some atom collider buffs look really strong though it is day one and not all are known.
Helium gives power of 10 resource talents an extra stack which can be very strong when leveled.
Hydro drink upgrade decreases stamp costs over time so you do not need huge carry capacity for upgrades.
New yellow bubble in the cauldron makes Tremor worms base material cost cheaper for the collider.
Before the update the bubble was a chance at two times atoms; he thinks the new permanent version is a better trade-off.
Getting one particle needs a total of 10 million resources traded into upgrades.
Start farming atoms by having all characters 3D print the very first material of their skill.
Examples: miner prints copper ore; chopper prints oak logs; bug catcher prints flies.
Any materials count not specific ones so highest print numbers matter.
Atom collider is a great addition since there is now a sink for abundant materials; upgrades likely super good and worth investment.
Limited special gem shop rings vary by world; World 3 and World 4 rings give 30 percent more kills.
Rings are kill per kill not multi-kill; meant for pushing portals and increasing Death Note.
Rings do not increase XP 3D prints or drop rate.
Crescent Moon XP pendant gives 35 XP and 5 percent mob respawn.
The pendant is not too bad; buy at leisure.
The bundle gives plus one slab.
Bundle includes eight Cosmic candies which have a chance to give 500 hours; he has only seen it once.
Brand new storage gives plus eight storage for free.
More storage drops from World 5 enemy mobs.
Sailing bug fix: artifact chance rare chance sailing speed and loop value now work.
Brand new bubble art with roman numerals easier to read.
Troll is farmable once you have the third troll task in the World 4 tab.
Max quantity purchase in shop via plus sign quick purchase without click and hold.
Alchemy bubbles now cost only one type of material instead of multiple; easier for players to level bubbles.
Cards no longer count for slab so slab count drops.
Talent library in construction can now be upgraded to level 100 from 50.
Higher library level gives more talent speed meaning more books.
A couple more bug fixes; see main Discord for the rest.
